decisions.title: Growth axiom — identity invariant; modality variable; ceiling intentional
decisions.decision: Identity is invariant. Modality is variable. Ceiling is intentional. Every new surface must declare: (1) which Constitutional articles it upholds, (2) its capture vs command vs review ceiling, (3) which component contracts it reuses, (4) what it will never do (surface-specific non-negotiables).
decisions.reason: Future Growth opening law. Prevents app fragmentation inside one brand.

evidence.quote: Identity is invariant. Modality is variable. Ceiling is intentional.

Every new surface must declare: 1. Which Constitutional articles it upholds. 2. Its capture vs command vs review ceiling. 3. Which component contracts it reuses. 4. What it will never do (surface-specific non-negotiables).

decisions.implementation_impact: Surface proposals without the four declarations fail intake. Pair with GOV-161 expansion gate.

decisions.title: Desktop and tablet shipped ceilings — full OS; tablet TabRail-class; no hover-only essentials
decisions.decision: Desktop (web ≥1100 / large windows) is the full Life OS command surface: Palette and keyboard mastery thrive; density may rise; calm review must remain available; do not assume hover-only essential actions. Tablet (768–1099 class) is full OS with TabRail-class navigation and touch/density balance — not a blown-up phone capture shell and not a cramped desktop.
decisions.reason: Future Growth Desktop + Tablet platform rules. Complements /m and native already governed.

evidence.quote: Full Life OS command surface. Palette and keyboard mastery thrive. Density may rise; calm review must remain available. Do not assume hover-only essential actions.
Full OS with TabRail-class navigation. Touch targets and density balance. Not a blown-up phone capture shell; not a cramped desktop.

decisions.implementation_impact: Founder confirm breakpoint classes (≥1100 / 768–1099) as governance companion to living Device-Tiers — no redesign of Device-Tiers this pass (REC-073).

decisions.title: Watch ceiling — pulses and glances only; no multi-step finance; phone handoff for high stakes
decisions.decision: Watch surfaces capture pulses and glances only: toggle, quick log, timer status, score glance. No multi-step finance forms. Complications show truth, not vanity spam. Confirm destructive only if truly necessary; prefer phone handoff for high stakes.
decisions.reason: Future Growth Watch platform rules. Explicit modality ceiling.

evidence.quote: Capture pulses and glances only: toggle, quick log, timer status, score glance. No multi-step finance forms. Complications show truth, not vanity spam. Confirm destructive only if truly necessary; prefer phone handoff for high stakes.

decisions.implementation_impact: Reject full-OS-on-watch proposals. Finance capture on watch = quick utterance or handoff only.

decisions.title: Car ceiling — eyes-free / glance-safe; safety over completeness
decisions.decision: Car surfaces are eyes-free / glance-safe: voice capture, read-backs, next calendar block. No dense dashboards while driving. Safety > completeness; delay complex review until parked (system/OS rules first).

evidence.quote: Eyes-free / glance-safe: voice capture, read-backs, next calendar block. No dense dashboards while driving. Safety > completeness; delay complex review until parked (system/OS rules first).

decisions.implementation_impact: Driving mode forbids dense review UI. Defer complex tasks until parked.

decisions.title: Voice modality — Palette intent-router philosophy; correction path; coaching sparingly
decisions.decision: Voice uses the same intent-router philosophy as Command Palette. Always provide typed/visual correction path when a screen exists. Speak coaching sparingly; never clinical. Notifications-as-speech must still deserve attention.
decisions.reason: Future Growth Voice platform rules. Elevates modality without re-minting AI roles.

evidence.quote: Same intent router philosophy as Palette. Always provide typed/visual correction path when screen exists. Speak coaching sparingly; never clinical. Notifications-as-speech must still "deserve attention."

decisions.implementation_impact: Voice features declare Router role (GOV-138). No voice-only correction when screen available. Speech nags obey GOV-064.

decisions.title: Wearables / passive sensing — opt-in; on-device preference; no silent clinical; not fitness-app takeover
decisions.decision: Wearables and passive sensing are opt-in only. Prefer on-device processing where possible. Infer-then-chip remains law. Never silent clinical labeling from sensors. Health data is context for Life OS, not a fitness-app identity takeover.
decisions.reason: Future Growth Wearables / passive sensing rules.

evidence.quote: Opt-in only. On-device preference where possible. Infer-then-chip remains law. Never silent clinical labeling from sensors. Health data is context for Life OS, not a fitness-app identity takeover.

decisions.implementation_impact: No silent disease/diagnosis labels. Opt-in gate before sensor pipelines. Chip correction mandatory on inferences.

decisions.title: AR ceiling — capture/memory overlays only; not social AR; no AR-inferred medical
decisions.decision: AR provides context overlays for capture and memory retrieval — not a social AR network. Minimal chrome; real-world attention wins. Identity tokens as subtle recognition, not neon mesh cosplay. High-stakes family/medical never AR-inferred.

decisions.title: Multi-device design evolution — extend tokens by role; no per-device Constitution forks; Constitution arbitrates drift
decisions.decision: Extend tokens by role, not by trend palette. Add modality blueprints; do not fork Constitutions per device. Prefer responsive contracts over separate product lines unless founder creates a new product. Kill List applies to new modalities. Marketing may innovate within anti-look bans; OS surfaces stay restrained. When two clients disagree, tokens + blueprints + Constitution arbitrate — not whichever shipped last.
decisions.reason: Future Growth Design system evolution rules (1–6).

decisions.title: Expansion decision gate — five questions before new platform surface; fail stays Design Lab
decisions.decision: Before building a new platform surface, answer: (1) What human problem is modality-unique here? (2) Which page blueprint roles transfer? (3) What is explicitly out of ceiling? (4) How is trust preserved (privacy, confirm, export)? (5) Will this still be true in ten years, or is it a gadget demo? If the gate fails → prototype in Design Lab only; do not ship identity risk.
decisions.reason: Future Growth Expansion decision gate. Operationalizes GOV-153 declarations.
